chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ashari, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Kufi, from Al-Abbas ibn Amir, from Aban, from one of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked, 'A man caught a fish and found a fish inside its belly.' He (peace be upon him) said, 'Both may be eaten together.'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to eat a fish that has another fish inside its stomach?
ai.summary: In this concise ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the permissibility of consuming both the host fish and its prey is affirmed, reflecting the general principle in Shia fiqh that fish are halal regardless of their internal contents. This hadith, recorded in *Al-Kafi*, serves as a foundational text for understanding the purity and edibility of aquatic creatures, distinguishing them from other marine animals that may require specific conditions for consumption.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashari, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Kufy, from Al Abbas Bin Amir, from Aban, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
I said, ‘A man entrapped a fish, so he found a fish inside of it’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘he can eat both of them together’.
en.sarwar: 14. Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Kufiy from al-‘Abbas ibn ‘Amir from Aban from certain persons of our people who has said the following:
“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who catches a fish and finds another fish inside it. He (the Imam) said, ‘He can use both of them for food.’”
